name: Oh My Android
description: Lets coding agents see and drive the Android Emulator and adb devices: dp-scaled screenshots, UI tree, taps, logcat, and dark mode, font scale, RTL and TalkBack switches; ships inside a free native macOS app (macOS 26+). Install: `brew install --cask ateymoori/tap/oh-my-android` · Registry: `io.github.ateymoori/oh-my-android`
